thesis: The episode introduces Adam Butler, chief investment officer at Resolve Asset Management, whose investment philosophy evolved from early experiences in the late 1990s tech bubble to embracing uncertainty and strategy specification. Butler recounts his career beginning in 1995, where he initially believed his success in trading competitions and growing a firm's omnibus account from $2 million to $8.5 million was due to skillful selection, only to later realize it was purely luck.
